subject: Analog Electronics
questionText:
For the Zener diode shown in the figure, the Zener 
voltage at knee is 7 V, the knee current is negligible 
and the Zener dynamic resistance is 10 . If the input 
voltage Vi range from 10 V to 16 V, the output voltage 
Vo ranges from 
 
 
(a) 7.00 to 7.29 V 
(b) 7.14 to 7.29 V 
 
(c) 7.14 to 7.43 V 
(d) 7.29 to 7.43 V
explanation: Practice Question from Analog Electronics DPP-02 (Analog Electronics Practice Sheet 02).
